propositions: Add a locked commit-and-push entrypoint that stages and commits a dirty tracker before delegating to push_tickets_branch, while preserving uncommitted inbound events and bridge-bot authorship.

Reuse the existing merge-recovery guard to block commits when rebase/merge recovery is in progress; strict mode raises PushDeliveryError with merge-recovery-blocked reason, default mode warns and returns without push.
Support supplied git identity (name/email) per commit via git -c configuration, falling back to ambient repository identity when omitted, and never mutate global or repository config.

Default best-effort mode tolerates lock/stage/commit failures by logging warnings and returning without push, retaining content for later retry; strict mode raises PushDeliveryError with stable reasons (commit-lock-timeout, stage-failed, commit-failed).
Always delegate to push_tickets_branch after optional commit, even when clean and locally-ahead, so persistent rejection under strict mode raises PushDeliveryError rather than reporting success.
Extend the private CLI adapter with commit-and-push action while keeping push action push-only; both share the one dependency-defined PushDeliveryError translation boundary.
